text:
Lina D: Quick design question — for the new Create Model Endpoint form, should we keep inline per-field errors OR show a persistent banner/toast with a short summary + focus jump? Accessibility and mobile UX tradeoffs.

Sam K: my vote is inline errors + a short top summary for long forms. inline is clearer for quick fixes. :+1:

Mike R: inline too. Toasts are easy to miss and they don't tie to the field. Also toast -> keyboard users can't easily find which field.

Anya P: a11y notes: when using inline errors, we must move focus to the first invalid field on submit and use aria-invalid + aria-describedby for the error message. If we provide a summary, make it role="alert" or aria-live="assertive" so screen readers announce it, and include a skip link to jump to the first error.

Ben J: small copy nit: can we avoid sole reliance on an asterisk for required? asterisk isn't exposed well to some screen readers and can be ambiguous. prefer inline label text: "Company name — Required" for critical fields.

Lina D: Agree re: required label. For the destructive path (Delete Endpoint) I'm leaning toward typed-confirm (user types the endpoint name) for Dedicated endpoints, but maybe a lighter modal for quick dev flows. Thoughts on blocking friction?

Sam K: typed-confirm for production-facing deletes, modal for dev-only. We should document the risk tiers.

Mike R: implementation detail suggestion for focus + announce — quick snippet we can reuse:

```
// after submit
const firstInvalid = form.querySelector('[aria-invalid="true"]');
if (firstInvalid) {
  firstInvalid.focus();
  const summary = document.getElementById('error-summary');
  summary.setAttribute('role', 'alert'); // triggers SR announcement
}
```

Anya P: also ensure the field error node has id and the input has aria-describedby pointing to it. avoid relying on placeholder or color alone.

Ben J: for required indicator style, propose we ship a design token: `requiredLabel = true | false` so product teams can toggle (asterisk vs label) while we measure confusion in analytics.

Lina D: sweet. next steps: I'll update the mockups with inline error states, add an accessible error-summary region, and sketch typed-confirm modal variants for Dedicated vs dev mode. assigning @Mike to implementation notes.

Mike R: on it — will add aria patterns to the component and a small unit test for focus.

deploy-bot: Reminder: design spec PR needs label `design/approved` to run the visual regression job.

Sam K: thanks everyone — will watch the PR and do a quick copy pass on the Required vs asterisk wording.
